entries.source: vial of elder vampire blood
entries.target: 一瓶吸血鬼长老的血液

entries.source: vial of elder vampire blood
entries.target: 一瓶吸血鬼长老的血液

entries.source: Don't drink it, even if it tells you to.
entries.target: 不要喝它，即使它开口叫你喝也不行。

entries.source: If you've the means to eliminate the little venom problem, these make miraculous instant drink-chilling straws.
entries.target: 如果你有办法解决那点小小的毒液问题，这些螫针就能充当神奇的吸管，瞬间把饮料冰镇。

entries.source: You'll need to find one with a ring, preferably an expensive one.
entries.target: 你得找一个戴着鼻环的，最好是戴着贵重鼻环的。

entries.source: vial of elder vampire blood
entries.target: 一瓶吸血鬼长老的血液

entries.source: Thick, clotted, and foul. The vial is cold to the touch.
entries.target: 粘稠的、凝固的、污秽的液体。瓶子摸起来很冷。

entries.source: Once you've gotten it, cross some moving water on your way back.
entries.target: 拿到之后，回来时记得渡过一处流水。

entries.source: multi-hued wyrm scale
entries.target: 多彩的龙鳞

entries.source: Beautiful and nearly impregnable. Separating it from the dragon must have been hard work.
entries.target: 美丽且异常坚固的龙鳞。把它从龙身上扒下来一定费了不少力气。

entries.source: If you think collecting one of these is hard, try liquefying one.
entries.target: 如果你认为收集一片龙鳞很困难，那么去尝试溶解它吧。

entries.source: giant spider spinneret
entries.target: 巨型蜘蛛的吐丝器

entries.source: An ugly, ripped-out chunk of giant spider. Bits of silk protrude from an orifice.
entries.target: 从巨型蜘蛛身上扯下的一大块丑陋的器官，少量的丝线从某个洞中伸出。

entries.source: The spiders in your barn won't do. You'll know a giant spider when you see one, though they're rare in Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 你家仓库里的蜘蛛是不行的。当你看到一只时，你就会明白什么是巨型蜘蛛，尽管在马基·埃亚尔这种蜘蛛很稀少。

entries.source: honey tree root
entries.target: 蜂蜜树的根

entries.source: The severed end of one of a honey tree's roots. It wriggles around occasionally, seemingly unwilling to admit that it's dead... and a *plant*.
entries.target: 从蜂蜜树的一根树根上切下来的断端。它偶尔会蠕动下，似乎不承认它已经死了，而且还是个“植物”。

entries.source: Keep a firm grip on it. These things will dig themselves right back into the ground if you drop them.
entries.target: 牢牢地抓住它，如果你不小心把它掉在地上，它会立刻挖地逃走。

entries.source: bloated horror heart
entries.target: 浮肿的恐魔心脏

entries.source: Diseased-looking and reeking. It seems to be decaying as you watch.
entries.target: 病变且散发着恶臭的心脏，在你注视它时似乎仍在腐烂。

entries.source: Don't worry if it dissolves. Just don't get any on you.
entries.target: 别担心它会溶解，只要别让它沾到你身上。

entries.source: electric eel tail
entries.target: 电鳗尾巴

entries.source: Slimy, wriggling, and crackling with electricity.
entries.target: 黏滑、蠕动的尾巴，还闪着噼啪作响的电火花。

entries.source: I know, I know. Where does the eel stop and the tail start? It doesn't much matter. The last ten inches or so should do nicely.
entries.target: 我知道，我知道。电鳗到哪儿为止、尾巴又从哪儿开始？其实没多大关系。最后十英寸左右就够了。

entries.source: vial of squid ink
entries.target: 一瓶乌贼墨汁

entries.source: Thick, black and opaque.
entries.target: 粘稠、黑色且不透明。

entries.source: However annoying this will be for you to gather, I promise that the reek it produces in my lab will prove even more annoying.
entries.target: 不管采集它会让你多么恼火，我保证它在我实验室里散发的恶臭会更令人受不了。

entries.source: bear paw
entries.target: 熊爪

entries.source: Large and hairy with flesh-rending claws. It smells slightly of fish.
entries.target: 这只熊掌又大又多毛，长着能撕裂血肉的利爪，闻起来略带鱼腥味。

entries.source: You'd think I could get one of these from a local hunter, but they've had no luck. Don't get eaten.
entries.target: 你大概以为我能从本地猎户手上弄到一个，可他们一直没那个运气。可别被吃掉了。

entries.source: ice wyrm tooth
entries.target: 冰霜巨龙的牙齿

entries.source: This tooth has been blunted with age, but still looks more than capable of doing its job.
entries.target: 这颗牙齿已随岁月磨钝，但看起来仍然完全足以胜任它的工作。

entries.source: Ice Wyrms lose teeth fairly often, so you might get lucky and not have to do battle with one. But dress warm just in case.
entries.target: 冰龙每隔一段时间会换齿，所以你幸运的话，可以捡到几颗而不需要和它战斗。不过保险起见，还是穿得暖和点。

entries.source: red crystal shard
entries.target: 红色水晶碎片

entries.source: Tiny flames still dance ethereally inside this transparent crystal, though its heat seems to have faded... you hope.
entries.target: 小巧的火焰依然在这颗透明的水晶里轻盈舞动，尽管它的热量似乎已经消退……你希望如此。

entries.source: I hear these can be found in a cave near Elvala. I also hear that they can cause you to spontaneously combust, so no need to explain if you come back hideously scarred.
entries.target: 我听说这些东西可以在埃尔瓦拉附近的洞穴里找到。我还听说它们会使你自燃，所以要是你回来时遍体伤疤，也用不着解释了。

entries.source: vial of fire wyrm saliva
entries.target: 一瓶火焰巨龙的唾液

entries.source: Clear and slightly thicker than water. It froths when shaken.
entries.target: 龙涎比水更加粘稠，和水一样清澈，当你摇晃它时会有泡沫产生。

entries.source: Keep this stuff well away from your campfire unless you want me to have to find a new, more alive adventurer.
entries.target: 让这瓶东西远离你的篝火，除非你想让我再去找一个新的、活着的冒险家。

entries.source: chunk of ghoul flesh
entries.target: 腐烂的食尸鬼肉块

entries.source: Rotten and reeking. It still twitches occasionally.
entries.target: 这块肉腐烂且散发着恶臭，偶尔还会抽搐。

entries.source: Unfortunately for you, the chunks that regularly fall off ghouls won't do. I need one freshly carved off.
entries.target: 告诉你一个不幸的消息，平时从食尸鬼身上掉下来的肉是不行的。我需要新鲜的，刚切下来的肉。

entries.source: mummified bone
entries.target: 木乃伊骨头

entries.source: Bits of dry flesh still cling to this ancient bone.
entries.target: 这根古老的骨头上仍残留着些许干肉。

entries.source: That is, a bone from a corpse that's undergone mummification. Actually, any bit of the body would do, but the bones are the only parts you're certain to find when you kick a mummy apart. I recommend finding one that doesn't apply curses.
entries.target: 那就是，经过木乃伊化的尸体身上的骨头。实际上，身体的任何部位都可以，只是踢散一具木乃伊后唯一保证能找到的就是骨头了。我推荐你找一具不会施加诅咒的木乃伊。

entries.source: sandworm tooth
entries.target: 沙虫之牙

entries.source: Tiny, dark grey, and wickedly sharp. It looks more like rock than bone.
entries.target: 它小巧、暗灰且锋利得吓人。它看起来更像石头而不是骨头。

entries.source: Yes, sandworms have teeth. They're just very small and well back from where you're ever likely to see them and live.
entries.target: 是的，沙虫也有牙齿。只是它们很小，而且长在很深的地方，你要是能看见它们，多半就活不成了。

entries.source: black mamba head
entries.target: 黑曼巴头

entries.source: Unlike the rest of the black mamba, the severed head isn't moving.
entries.target: 与黑曼巴身体的其余部分不同，这颗被斩下的头一动不动。

entries.source: If you get bitten, I can save your life if you still manage to bring back the head... and if it happens within about a minute from my door. Good luck.
entries.target: 如果你被咬了，只要还能把头带回来，而且遇袭地点离我门口只有大约一分钟路程，我就能救你。祝你好运。

entries.source: snow giant kidney
entries.target: 雪巨人的肾脏

entries.source: As unpleasant-looking as any exposed organ.
entries.target: 和任何外露的器官一样难看。

entries.source: I suggest not killing the snow giant by impaling it through the kidneys. You'll just have to find another.
entries.target: 我建议你不要从雪巨人的肾脏部位刺死它，否则你不得不寻找另外一个。

entries.source: storm wyrm claw
entries.target: 风暴巨龙的爪子

entries.source: Bluish and wickedly sharp. It makes your arm hair stand on end.
entries.target: 这只爪子泛着蓝色光泽并且锋利得吓人，它使你汗毛竖立。

entries.source: I recommend severing one of their dewclaws. They're smaller and easier to remove, but they've never been blunted by use, so be careful you don't poke yourself. Oh yes, and don't get eaten.
entries.target: 我建议切下它们的一个悬爪。悬爪更小、更容易切下，但从未因使用而磨钝，所以小心别扎到自己。哦，对了，也别被吃掉。

entries.source: green worm
entries.target: 绿色蠕虫

entries.source: A dead green worm, painstakingly separated from its tangle of companions.
entries.target: 一只死掉的绿色虫子，需要非常仔细才能把它从蠕虫团中挑拣出来。

entries.source: Try to get any knots out before returning. Wear gloves.
entries.target: 回来之前尽量把缠结都解开。记得戴手套。

entries.source: vial of wight ectoplasm
entries.target: 一瓶尸妖灵质

entries.source: Cloudy and thick. Only by bottling it can you prevent it from evaporating within minutes.
entries.target: 浑浊且粘稠的液体。只有把它装进瓶子里，才能防止它在几分钟内蒸发。

entries.source: If you ingest any of this, never mind coming back here. Please.
entries.target: 如果你吞下了任何一点，就别再回来了。拜托。

entries.source: xorn fragment
entries.target: 索尔石碎片

entries.source: Looks much like any other rock, though this one was recently sentient and trying to murder you.
entries.target: 它看起来和其他石头没什么两样，只不过这块不久前还具有意识，并且曾试图杀死你。

entries.source: Avoid fragments that contained the xorn's eyes. You've no idea how unpleasant it is being watched by your ingredients.
entries.target: 不要带回包含着索尔石怪眼睛的碎片。你不知道被你的原材料盯着是多么难受的一件事。

entries.source: warg claw
entries.target: 座狼爪

entries.source: Unpleasantly large and sharp for a canine's claw.
entries.target: 这只爪子对于犬科动物而言大得反常，也锋利得吓人。

entries.source: My usual ingredient gatherers draw the line at hunting wargs. Feel free to mock them on your way back.
entries.target: 我平时找原料的那些人一听说要猎杀座狼就不干了。回来时尽管嘲笑他们吧。

entries.source: pouch of faeros ash
entries.target: 一袋法罗灰烬

entries.source: Unremarkable grey ash.
entries.target: 不起眼的灰色灰烬。

entries.source: They're creatures of pure flame, and likely of extraplanar origin, but the ash of objects consumed by their fire has remarkable properties.
entries.target: 它们是由纯粹的火焰组成的生物，似乎来自另一个世界。然而，被它们的火焰烧尽之物留下的灰烬有着非凡的功效。

entries.source: wretchling eyeball
entries.target: 小劣魔之眼

entries.source: Small and bloodshot. Its dead gaze still burns your skin.
entries.target: 小而充血。它死寂的目光仍灼痛着你的皮肤。

entries.source: Evil little things, wretchlings. Feel free to kill as many as you can, though I just need the one intact eyeball.
entries.target: 邪恶的小东西——小劣魔。你可以尽情地杀戮它们，尽管我只需要一只完整的眼球。

entries.source: faerlhing fang
entries.target: 费尔荷毒牙

entries.source: It still drips venom and crackles with magical energy.
entries.target: 它仍滴着毒液，魔法能量在上面噼啪作响。

entries.source: I've lost a number of adventurers to this one, but I'm sure you'll be fine.
entries.target: 为了这东西，我已经折损了许多冒险者，但我确信你会安全归来。

entries.source: vampire lord fang
entries.target: 吸血鬼领主的尖牙

entries.source: Brilliantly white, but surrounded by blackest magic.
entries.target: 牙齿亮白耀眼，周身却萦绕着至邪的黑暗魔法。

entries.source: You should definitely consider not pricking yourself with it.
entries.target: 你必须确保自己不会被它划伤。
